experiment: Vol.1 (renewed), P70 · the 128-request headline re-checked in a window with no other GPU load: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct on one RTX 5090, P59's four configurations (NIM 2.0.12 bf16 and fp8, Ollama 4-bit and fp16), profile C (200 / 200 tokens), 1, 32 and 128 concurrent requests.
written_before: the first measured cell. run_p70.sh refuses to start if this file or its .sha256 is missing or changed, or if levels.jsonl exists.
why: P59, the source of the Vol.1 headline (128 concurrent requests: NIM bf16 5,458 tok/s against the 4-bit Ollama build's 741, 7.4x), ran on 2026-09-25 from 02:32 to 06:44 with other load on the desktop GPU: its levels ended at 3-23% utilization (median 5) and 45-70 W before they started, where a window with no other load ends at 0% (tools/g8_gate.py). The arms ran one after another, 30-60 minutes apart, so the background need not have been the same for both, nor have cost both the same share. The decision to re-measure is made from that fingerprint, before any clean number is seen.
scope: Profile C only, three levels, main containers. P59's harness is imported unchanged. This run changes no published file.

ollama_num_parallel.source: P59's fitted values (events_public.jsonl container_start env), set directly instead of re-fitting

design.order: one container per configuration: N-BF16 -> O-Q4 -> N-FP8 -> O-FP16, each running c = 1, 32, 128 in turn
design.why_not_interleaved_by_c: interleaving by c needs twelve container starts (six NIM loads of several minutes each) instead of four; every cell is gated by G8 immediately before it, which is what interleaving would protect against
design.per_container: isolation check, prefix-cache detector, discarded 120 s warm-up at c=1 (seed 20260925 + 9000), calibration (20 requests), as P59
design.per_cell: G8 (10 s at 1 Hz; util p50 <= 2 % and power p50 <= 45 W; retry every 60 s up to 15 min, else the cell is null); AIPerf C profile, 60 s, seed 20260925 + c, as P59; then the no-overwrite check (tools/overwrite_gate.py): tracked files unchanged and new files only under this run's directory, else the run stops and the cell is void
design.g8_positive_control: once, in the first NIM container after calibration: G8 sampled while 4 streams decode on the engine; it must not pass
design.differences_from_p59_by_cell: in P59 each container ran 1, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 (and profile R after C); here 1, 32, 128. The Ollama slot counts are set to P59's fitted values instead of being re-fitted. Nothing else differs (images, profiles, models, context, AIPerf command, seeds, durations).

gates.arm: P59's (p59_analyze.py): residency (Ollama 100% GPU; NIM CUDA graphs captured) and health (decode rate at c=1 x bytes per token / 1,792 GB/s >= 0.40)
gates.cell: P59's cell checks plus G8 passed before it and the no-overwrite check passed after it

predictions.R1: N-BF16 / O-Q4 total tok/s at 128 within 6.7-8.1 (7.4 +- 10%)
predictions.R2: N-FP8 / O-Q4 and N-BF16 / O-FP16 at 128 each within P59's value +- 10%
predictions.R3: at 1 request the 4-bit build is still faster than NIM bf16 (P59: N-BF16 / O-Q4 = 0.505)
predictions.R4: each cell's total tok/s is reported beside P59's same cell; no statement of the form 'the background slowed X by Y%' is made
predictions.reading_of_predictions: a failed prediction is reported as failed; nothing is re-run to chase a result

analysis_rules.program: vol1a-revisit/scripts/p70_analyze.py (10 self-test cases; each of 8 mutations -- the band, the tolerance, the G8, overwrite, arm-gate and P59 cell-check joins, a ratio's direction, R3's direction -- makes at least one fail), reading only the published files and P59's analysis.json
